entities.name: Nøstvet and Lihult cultures
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The Nøstvet culture and the Lihult culture are two very similar Mesolithic cultures in Scandinavian prehistory, derived from the earlier Fosna-Hensbacka cultures. They are so varied and vaguely defined that they are rather a tradition than an archaeological culture.
